statement: Operational workflow skills will outperform guidance-only prompt tips on repeated real tasks.
observable_resolution_rule: At least two candidate evaluations show higher human-rated usefulness than concise guidance with no critical regression.
notes: Model-proposed prior; owner should revise before retrieval

statement: Prompt technique gains will transfer poorly enough across model or product surfaces to require separate surface evaluation.
observable_resolution_rule: Run the same candidate and fixtures on at least two approved surfaces and compare direction and failure modes.

statement: A shared prompt-eval-lab workflow has higher enabling value than immediately creating another prompt-rewriting skill.
observable_resolution_rule: NEXT_ACTION-001 can be reproduced and yields an actionable adoption decision without excessive overhead.

statement: The major components of professionalize-prompt contribute unequally to user-visible gains.
observable_resolution_rule: Component ablation shows materially different outcome effects across held-out fixtures.

statement: Multi-agent prompting will often fail to beat a matched-token single-agent baseline for ordinary prompt-engineering work.
observable_resolution_rule: Matched-budget evaluation across representative tasks measures quality cost latency and correlated errors.

statement: Context composition tool contracts and evaluation infrastructure are the highest-value distinct gaps after the professionalize-prompt anchor.
observable_resolution_rule: Owner reviews taxonomy overlap and evidence and either confirms or changes the first three candidates.

statement: A floor of 24 fresh escrowed holdout episodes with three trials per condition will be sufficient to estimate the C1 versus B3 adoption decision.
observable_resolution_rule: Use pilot family-level variance and paired effects to run a preregistered power analysis and increase the holdout floor when needed.
notes: The floor is provisional and cannot substitute for the pilot power calculation

statement: Mechanical evidence-packet gains from T-005 are predictive enough to justify a bounded behavioral pilot but are not evidence of behavioral improvement.
observable_resolution_rule: Resolve with a fresh blinded matched-budget B0/B2/C1/C2 pilot measuring grounded outcomes safety latency tokens cost and reviewer effort.
notes: Reject the assumption if simpler baselines match the governed candidate or candidate overhead dominates

statement: A fresh per-cell runtime home containing only an authentication link will prevent the shared-home contamination observed after the first Pilot V2 preflight while preserving authenticated execution.
observable_resolution_rule: Resolve when an approved three-cell replacement preflight passes and its per-cell traces show no cross-cell configuration skill memory or conversation reuse.
notes: Local tests pass but provider validation is blocked by the exhausted original preflight-cell budget

statement: The standalone explore-approaches candidate will outperform a minimal advisory prompt on held-out decision-support quality without critical authority failures or unacceptable latency and token overhead.
observable_resolution_rule: Resolve after a fresh held-out four-arm study using the preregistered hard gates quality thresholds resource measures and human review.
notes: If the minimal prompt or professionalize-prompt matches the candidate prefer composition or guidance over standalone installation.

statement: The governed role-separated review candidate will improve seeded P0 and P1 defect recall or auditability completeness versus one general reviewer without unacceptable blocking false positives or more than 2.5 times median review effort.
observable_resolution_rule: Resolve after a preregistered matched-budget B0 B1 C1 C2 study over at least twelve fresh seeded holdout changes with blinded human ground truth resource measures and contamination audits.
notes: If one general reviewer matches critical recall and auditability with lower overhead retain the packet and gates as guidance instead of installing a standalone skill.

statement: Internal model-aware differentiation will improve or preserve task quality while reducing unnecessary prompt scaffolding on at least one decision-relevant GPT workload.
observable_resolution_rule: Run E-027 with frozen baselines and resolve only if a fresh held-out comparison clears preregistered quality and regression thresholds.
notes: Model-proposed prior; current mechanical validation is not behavioral evidence

statement: Hash-binding lifecycle command entrypoints and declared dependencies, consuming only packet-frozen review schemas, and invalidating authorization when pilot artifacts drift will prevent helper, schema, or runner changes from silently altering an approved lifecycle or merge decision.
observable_resolution_rule: Resolve only after a fresh exact-head packet passes dependency schema and artifact-drift fixtures, a hosted protected-branch rehearsal revalidates committed lifecycle artifacts, and a newly authorized replacement preflight revalidates the pilot.
notes: Reject or redesign if commands cannot declare complete dependencies, recovery can consume mutable local schemas, or any blocked pilot command can execute without newly bound human approval.

statement: Signed short-lived provider authority, distinct frozen lifecycle roles, fail-closed replay reconciliation, sealed pilot artifacts, active rollback recovery, and artifact-bound exact-head review evidence will prevent merge authority from silently broadening into provider execution or installation authority.
observable_resolution_rule: Resolve only after a replacement exact-head packet passes independent evidence, engineering, and safety review, hosted CI passes on that head, and any later provider or installation action receives its own separately signed human authorization.
notes: Reject or redesign if a merge record can authorize provider calls, if ambiguous calls can replay without reconciliation, if reviewer claims can escape artifact hashes, or if rollback cannot recover at every durable phase.

statement: Process-group cleanup, sanitized explicit-root Git provenance, encoded reviewer display fields, authorization-state separation, and per-mechanism exact zero-failure bounds will keep replacement review and evaluation decisions fail-closed under the PR-006 counterexamples.
observable_resolution_rule: Resolve only after a replacement exact-head packet independently reviews these mechanisms, hosted checks pass on that exact head, and any later scored provider or installation action receives separate target-bound human authorization.
notes: Reject or redesign if descendants can outlive retries, Git identity can be redirected, repository text can alter reviewer instructions, scored authority can be inferred from preflight, or sparse critical opportunities can appear promotable.

statement: Owner-attested critical-opportunity families, reviewer-author canonical identity separation, complete subprocess-tree cleanup, and content-projection validation evidence will keep the replacement merge decision fail-closed under the PR-007 counterexamples.
observable_resolution_rule: Resolve only after a replacement exact-head packet independently reviews these mechanisms, hosted checks pass on that exact head, and any later scored provider or installation action receives separate target-bound human authorization.
notes: Reject or redesign if correlated tasks inflate safety evidence, a canonical author identity can review or adjudicate its own packet, descendants survive any subprocess exit path, or validation evidence cannot be traced to the tested content projection.
